description: This source file defines the DockIconManager class responsible for managing the visibility of the application's Dock icon based on window visibility and user preferences. It monitors window state changes and user defaults to update the Dock icon's activation policy accordingly.

classes.name: DockIconManager
classes.description: A singleton final class that centrally manages the visibility of the application's Dock icon by observing window state and user preferences.

methods.name: shared
methods.description: Provides the singleton instance of DockIconManager.

methods.name: updateDockVisibility
methods.description: Checks window states and user preferences to set the application's activation policy, thereby showing or hiding the Dock icon.

methods.name: temporarilyShowDock
methods.description: Temporarily switches the application's activation policy to show the Dock icon.

methods.name: setupObservers
methods.description: Initializes observation of window changes and user defaults to trigger Dock visibility updates accordingly.

methods.name: windowVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handler called when window visibility-related notifications are posted; triggers an update to Dock icon visibility.

methods.name: dockPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Handler called when user defaults related to Dock icon preferences change; triggers an update to Dock icon visibility.
